text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is McQueen! Of all the Mejiros, 
it's Mejiro McQueen!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so very much for your 
cheers!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I shall continue to dedicate myself to 
victory. With the finest run that leads to 
the Mejiro family's spring!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers praising the winner echo through 
the Winner's Circle. Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We carry Ines Fujin to the waiting room. 
After a brief medical check, we were told 
there was nothing wrong with her.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I see. I collapsed again, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I feel so pathetic. Causing trouble for 
everyone, making them worry. And yet, 
everything I do is half-baked.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I was supposed to find a way. Those kids 
were watching the Kikuka Sho, too. In the 
end, if this is all I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Um, that's— Ah... well...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Um, I caused a big fuss before the race, 
and then I collapsed right after running, 
so... Um... I'm so, so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm totally fine. I am. This time was 
just an exception, I won't mess up next 
time! No matter what it takes...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin insists desperately that she's 
fine, but she doesn't look it at all.
choice_data_list: …Aines, if something's wrong, talk to me

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's nothing at all. I'm fine, 
really...
choice_data_list: I want to cherish what's precious to you.

I want to treasure the things that are 
precious to you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to protect a single 
thing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The tension held in her eyes was on the 
verge of overflowing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I only heard about it for the first 
time when I went back home the other day.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"My little sisters quit dancing. They said 
it was so they could help out around the 
house together."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"My mom's always been frail, you see. 
Lately it flared up again, and apparently 
she's been going in and out of the 
hospital."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And then my little sisters said, 'Since 
Big Sis isn't at home, we're gonna help 
Mom out ourselves!'...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...It's because I was selfish and left 
home just because I wanted to run.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Why did the two of you quit dancing!? 
If Big Sis just quits racing and comes 
back home, everything would be solved!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! You just don't get it, 
Sis!! Just get out of the house already!!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
If you come back here, I'm gonna hate you! 
I'll never talk to you again, Big Sis!!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
"Even though Lou and I made up our minds, 
if Big Sister stops running... !"

text_block_list.name: Ines's Father
text_block_list.text:
Fu. Go and run. We all talked it over. So 
don't worry about the family—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...So as long as "Big Sis doesn't quit 
running," you two are happy, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Neither of you need to do the housework. 
Housekeeping services exist these days, 
right? I'll cover the money to hire one 
with my part-time job earnings.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"So please, don't let go of your dream. 
...Promise me you won't, ever!!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...I worked part-time and sent more money 
home. But then they both started worrying 
that I'd ruin my health."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to reassure you. —That I wasn't 
pushing myself too hard. I even adjusted 
my running so my stamina wouldn't run out, 
all to blow away any worries you had.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I didn't want you to see me 
collapse... not at the Kikuka Sho..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: In the end, if things stay like this...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha, sorry! It wasn't actually that big of 
a deal!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's so pathetic of me, right? When other 
girls are born into famous families and 
fight under way more pressure than this.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Man, if you're gonna stress over 
something, make it an injury or something 
that actually affects your racing career, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, this is ridiculous! It's 
just family stuff, so you don't need to 
worry about it, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: It's an important issue for you, isn't it?

This is an important matter to you, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list:
Don't bottle it all up by yourself. Let's 
think it through together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *sob*, Waaahhh...! 
...Waaahh-aaannn...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin finally lets the tears she had 
been holding back begin to fall.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gently held her from behind to keep her 
from falling apart as she sobbed, her 
shoulders trembling—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And around the time her tears subsided, 
the two of us decided to think about what 
comes next.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: About the future, huh...
choice_data_list: Why don't you try taking it easy for now?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...... ...Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to, just a little. Until I can do 
something about the current situation.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Is it okay if the goal I work toward... 
is as far away as early spring?"
choice_data_list: Then how about the Osaka Hai?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai is a spring GⅠ. At 2000m on 
turf, distance won't be an issue, and it's 
held at the same Hanshin Racecourse as the 
Asahi Hai FS.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...That might be nice. If that's the 
case... That sounds good."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And a few days after the Kikuka Sho, I 
made a call to help support Ines Fujin 
moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rrrr-ring... rrrr-ring...)

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, is this the Trainer? ...Thank you 
as always for taking such good care of my 
daughter."
choice_data_list: Likewise, thank you for all your support.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"‘I apologize for being unable to reach 
you by phone sooner. ...This is regarding 
the matter you contacted me about earlier, 
correct?’"

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Um, actually, I have a request of my own. 
I know it's terribly forward under these 
circumstances, but in the Arima Kinen, 
please let my daughter—"
